events.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s underway now — folks are dropping off tools and supplies all morning. I can swing by later and let you know what still needs doing.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Rey: That’d be great, Tess. I’ll check in later and see where I can help.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep an ear out and report back if they still need hands or haul-offs.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Rey: I can help, Gus — what kind of repair drive are we talking about?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Mostly a quick tool-and-fix drive — folks bring in busted stuff, and I lend whatever gear they need to patch it up.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rey: That sounds handy. I can bring a few tools and help out if you want.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Faye: That works for me — I can plan around school pickup then. Send the address when you have it, and I’ll try to help coordinate.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll send the address as soon as I get it. Thanks for helping coordinate; I’ll let you know if they still need hands later.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Faye: Absolutely — just keep me posted, and I’ll work around pickup if they still need help.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Rey: That sounds handy. I can bring a few tools and help out if you want.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Thanks—that helps, but I still need the timing and the exact drop-off spot before I move anything. Also let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to bring.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll check on the timing and drop-off spot, then let you know. If you want, I can bring a hammer, screwdriver set, and a tape measure.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: I’ve only been catching fragments, so I’m still piecing it together. If you hear anything about tools or spare parts, I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — if you hear about any missing tools or spare parts, please let me know. I’ll keep an ear out too.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday morning at the community center lot, and if you can bring any repair items or a basic tool kit, that’d be great.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Got it — I can bring a basic tool kit this Saturday morning. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you still need.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — a basic tool kit is perfect. I’ll send the exact time and address now, and if anything else comes up I’ll let you know.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — I’ll send over any specific needs as soon as we lock the plan. If you want, I can also loop in a few more neighbors for Saturday morning.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Sure, feel free to loop them in — I can bring my basic tool kit on Saturday morning.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: I’ve got the tape and screws set aside, and I’m still sorting through my spare tools. Just send me the repair drive time and address when you have them, and I’ll help point folks the right way.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rey: I’m thinking we should pin down the exact drop-off spot first, then the time so everyone can find it easily. Once that’s set, I can send it along to everyone.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: That works for me — just let me know the drop-off spot and time, and I’ll pass it along to folks.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Opal: Could you send me the time and exact drop-off spot for the repair drive again? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I commit.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: I don’t have the exact time or drop-off spot yet. If you send me the details, I can help keep them straight.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: I don’t have them handy either, so I’m still waiting on the exact time and drop-off spot before I commit.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: Got it — Saturday morning at the community center lot. I’ll bring a basic tool kit and see what else I can spare.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll loop in Faye and send the time and address along if anything changes.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Sounds good — just send me any updates, and I’ll be there Saturday morning.
events.speaker: Rey
